subject: Kickoff: MAP draft, evaluation canvas, and closing timeline
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena@helixai.com>, Tom Jenkins <tom.j@helixai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: MAP draft, evaluation canvas, and closing timeline

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for the time earlier. As discussed, I put together a lightweight MAP starter and a matching slide deck we can use for the kickoff and for tracking acceptance criteria. My goal is to land a version you can share with stakeholders by next Friday so the pilot can start the week after.

Top asks for the kickoff:
- Confirm three success metrics for your evaluation (performance, cost, acceptance criteria)
- List the internal HelixAI stakeholders who will own infra, data, and security signoffs
- Confirm a target close window (we suggested ~6 weeks from pilot start)

I attached an editable MAP_Starter_Template (GDoc) and a one-page slide deck with proposed owners and a 6-week timeline. For this first pass I assigned internal owners tentatively — please flag any changes.

Proposed kickoff: Mon Apr 12, 10:00–10:45 PT (30–45 min) — we’ll use that time to walk the MAP and align on evaluation gating. Does that work?

Links / attachments: MAP_Starter_Template.gdoc (editable), MAP_Deck_Authors_v1.gslides (slide authors + timeline)

Next steps from us if you confirm kickoff: we’ll convert the doc into a short checklist, add a mini acceptance test suite for the evaluation, and share a HubSpot record with milestones.

Thanks —
Lauren 
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Success Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0192

---
Attachment stubs: MAP_Starter_Template.gdoc (Google Doc link), MAP_Deck_Authors_v1.gslides (Google Slides link)

From: Elena Morris <elena@helixai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Jenkins <tom.j@helixai.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP draft, evaluation canvas, and closing timeline

Thanks Lauren — this looks great and reasonable. Monday 10:00 PT works for us. A few quick notes:
- We prefer the evaluation success metrics be phrased as pass/fail checkpoints rather than fuzzy targets; can your team add a short acceptance test for "response-time P95 < 350ms" and "embedding similarity > 0.82"?
- Security owner will be Tom Jenkins (cc’d). Tom — can you confirm you have a SOC2 checklist and whether you need any log exports during pilot?
- We’d like to compress the close window to 4–5 weeks if the pilot hits the acceptance criteria earlier.

I’ll review the doc and add stakeholder names directly. Please keep the MAP editable; we’ll co-author.

Best,
Elena
Elena Morris
Head of ML Ops, HelixAI
elena@helixai.com

Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: author assignments and next edits for HelixAI MAP (do-not-forward)

Marissa / Aditya / Sofia — quick alignment before the Monday kickoff.

Elena asked for the acceptance tests called out explicitly (P95 and embedding threshold). Tasks:
- Marissa: add the "evaluation test cases" section to the GDoc (one paragraph per test + owner). Preferably include a test harness note for Data team.
- Aditya: update the slide deck timeline to show a 4–6 week close window and annotate where we’d trigger a rollout decision.
- Sofia: add a short security evidence appendix — stub list (SOC2 artifact list, log exports, retention), then share links to the compliance pack.

Please make edits inline by EOD Friday so we can send the updated doc to Helix before Monday. I’ll handle the kickoff agenda and the invite.

Thanks —
Lauren

Hi Elena / Tom — thanks for the quick note and for confirming Tom as security owner.

We made the edits you requested: added the two acceptance tests as explicit pass/fail checks, compressed the slide timeline to show a 4–6 week close window, and added a compliance appendix with SOC2 artifact pointers (Sofia added the stubbed list). I also added a short test harness note for the data team.

Final links for Monday (editable):
- MAP starter (GDoc): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcMAPStarter/edit
- MAP deck (Slides): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1zXyMAPDeck/edit

Kickoff confirmed: Mon Apr 12, 10:00–10:45 PT. Agenda attached to the calendar invite.

See you Monday —
Lauren
